title: Rav Chaim Yaakov Zilberberg Passes
body: Rav Chaim Yaakov Naftali Zilberberg z”l, 75, collapsed before Kiddush at Pnei Menachem Rosh Yeshivah, led by Rav Shaul Alter. He was born to Reb Yitzchak Yissachar.

title: Zurich Gets Its First Eruv
body: Jewish residents of Zurich mark first Shabbos with new fully halachic eruv encircling the city's Jewish neighborhoods, joining cities worldwide.
